newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia to amend copyright act for multimedia.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia to amend copyright act for multimedia.

text.p: Malaysia will amend its copyright act to clarify provisions relating to protection of multimedia products, the national Bernama news agency reported on Tuesday.

"The Copyright Act needs to be amended this year as it will help protect investors in the Multimedia Super Corridor (MSC)," Bernama quoted Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs Minister Abu Hassan Omar as telling reporters.

The MSC is being developed as an investment zone for world-class information technology firms. It stretches from Kuala Lumpur to a new international airport and administrative capital, some 70 km (42 miles) to the south.
Rapid changes in information technology had created a need for better intellectual property protection of multimedia products, Abu Hassan said.
The amendment was intended to update the Copyright Act which was originally drafted to cover traditional forms of media, he said. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-230 8911)
